resources.string: I\'m a small, lazy roommate who lives on your screen. I make short jokes, and before the apps you choose, I ask you to pause for a moment. You\'re always free to leave or stay.
So I can sit on your screen

To appear above other apps, Android needs your permission called \"Display over other apps\". I only use it to show my little sprite and the pause card. I can\'t see what\'s inside other apps, and I can\'t tap or type for you.
Got it. I\'m on the screen now.
So I know which app is open

Android calls this \"Usage access\". I use it to read only the name of the app you\'re currently using and how long it\'s been open. I never read messages, posts, screens or anything you type. This stays on your phone.
Done. I can see app names, nothing more.

What I can\'t do, by design: I have no internet permission, so nothing leaves your phone. I can\'t read your messages. I can\'t take screenshots. I can\'t use your microphone, camera, location or contacts.
If the permission is greyed out
Open your phone\'s Settings and go to Apps.
Tap the three-dot menu (usually in the top right).
Tap \"Allow restricted settings\" and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint if asked.
Come back here and try the permission again.
Menus differ by phone and Android version. If you don\'t see these exact words, look for something similar.
Android needs a persistent notification so I can keep running. It has buttons to nap me or wake me. I won\'t use it to send promotions or nag you.
Keep me from being put to sleep
Some phones close background apps to save battery, which stops me from working. A few settings can prevent that. It takes a minute.

Menus differ by phone and Android version. If you can\'t find these exact words, look for the closest match.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, a few settings keep Jixxy running.
Open Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Jixxy. Turn on Autostart. Open \"Battery saver\" for Jixxy and choose \"No restrictions\".
On Oppo and Realme phones, background apps can be closed automatically.
Open Settings → Apps → App management → Jixxy. Turn on \"Allow auto-launch\" and \"Allow background activity\". In Battery, choose \"Don\'t optimise\".
On Vivo phones, background limits can stop Jixxy from running.
Open Settings → Battery → Background power consumption → Jixxy → Allow. In Apps, turn on Autostart for Jixxy.
On Samsung phones, unused apps can be put to sleep.
Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits. Remove Jixxy from \"Sleeping apps\" and add it to \"Never sleeping apps\".
On most other phones, one battery setting is usually enough.
Open Settings → Apps → Jixxy → Battery. Choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Don\'t optimise\".

Jixxy has no internet permission, no analytics, no ads and no accounts. It reads only the name of the app you have open and how long you\'ve had it open. It doesn\'t read messages, screens, or anything you type, and it never uses your camera, microphone, location or contacts. Everything it logs stays on your phone, and you can clear it any time.
